_how_to_use: Fill every field, delete unused ones, pass JSON.stringify(this) as the prompt to fal/flux-2-pro with refs. Refs are 'image 1', 'image 2'. No negative prompts on FLUX.2 (checked 2026-10).
scene: Claudia relaxing in a vintage lounge in the early evening

subjects.description: Claudia from image 1: 28-year-old adult woman, glossy jet-black jaw-length blunt bob, heavy straight bangs just above the brows, vivid copper-orange streak panels through the front bangs and one side, small orange hair clip, small thin gold hoops, light freckles, warm brown eyes, fine-line arm tattoos
subjects.wardrobe: olive-green fine-knit crop cami with a scalloped copper-orange edged neckline and small orange embroidered stars, star pendant on layered silver chains, red-and-green tartan mini skirt with a studded black belt
subjects.position: centre, leaning back against a dark wood dresser, hips angled to camera left
subjects.action: lowering oversized black oval sunglasses with one hand, looking over them into the lens

background: butter-yellow wall with three framed botanical cross-stitch prints, a brass table lamp with a pleated cream shade on the dresser
lighting: warm tungsten lamp key from camera left, soft falloff, gentle shadow on the right cheek
composition: medium shot from the waist up, rule of thirds, lamp in the left third
camera: Fujifilm X-T5, 50mm f/1.8, eye level, shallow depth of field, focus on her eyes
style: photoreal editorial, Kodak Gold 200, gentle grain, natural skin texture with visible pores, no text, no logos
